newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Pequiven raises output 6.7 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Pequiven raises output 6.7 pct in 1996.

text.p: Venezuela's state-owned petrochemical company Pequiven expects production in 1996 of 7.211 million tonnes, 6.7 percent more than in 1995, the company's President Arnold Volkenborn said Tuesday.
Volkenborn told a news conference that Pequiven expects to more than double production to reach 18.4 million tonnes by 2006 thanks to investments of $5.9 billion over the next ten years.
About $2.4 billion of the investment program will be carried out during the next three years, he said.
"Venezuela will become the principal petrochemical pole in South America," Volkenborn said.
